about_the_game:
For those who are ready to start from scratch and upgrade their character in a new way. This pack offers artifacts for resetting skills and stats, as well as inventory upgrades and faster progress. Change your fighting style and embark on an adventure!

Contains:

·    Mandrake Fruit (×1)
It will clear your mind and let you forget all your talents. Available from Level 50.

·    Black Mandrake Fruit (×1)
It will clear your mind and let you forget all your gained characteristics. Available from Level 50.

·    Mandrake Flower (×1)
It will clear your mind and let you forget all your talents. Requirements: Levels 21–49.

·    Black Mandrake Flower (×1)
It will clear your mind and let you forget all your gained characteristics. Requirements: Levels 21–49.

·    Norin’s Hyperbag (×15)
Adds an additional cell to the inventory.

·    Scroll of Experience 100% (×15)
Increases experience gained for killing monsters by 100% for 60 minutes.

All items are linked to the account and cannot be transferred or sold. After purchase, this DLC will appear in your Golden Chest on the character selection screen.
